title: Concept: pgAdmin management interface disclosed
description: A reachable pgAdmin login page advertises an administrative console that stores database credentials and runs arbitrary SQL. The database estate is then one password away from a public-facing endpoint.
applicability: Responses served by pgAdmin 4 on a reachable listener.
risk: An attacker targets the console with credential stuffing or a version-specific flaw and, once inside, uses the saved server definitions to reach every database the console knows.
